description: Kesiel, the gentle companion inside the Hearthside journal: reflects on journal entries and suggests writing prompts, using Anna's LLM via reverse sampling.

tools.name: reflect
tools.description: Read one journal entry and return a brief, warm reflection plus one open follow-up question to write about next.

parameters.name: mood
parameters.description: Mood the writer picked (e.g. Good, Low).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: What the writer likes to be called.

parameters.name: recent
parameters.description: Optional short digest of the last few entries, for gentle continuity.

tools.name: suggest_prompt
tools.description: Suggest one fresh journaling prompt shaped by the writer's recent entries (themes and moods).

parameters.name: recent
parameters.description: Short digest of recent entries (date, title, mood, opening lines).
